title: Women in Distress and Detention Fund Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Women in Distress and Detention Fund Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

WOMEN IN DISTRESS AND DETENTION FUND
WOMEN IN DISTRESS
AND DETENTION FUND
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE CXII OF
2002
(An Ordinance to
amend the Women in Distress and Detention Fund Act, 1996)
[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary Part I, 5th November, 2002]
F. No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
5-11-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Women in Distress and
Detention Fund (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Women in Distress and Detention Fund Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 5, Act XV of 1996

WOMEN IN DISTRESS AND DETENTION FUND
WOMEN IN DISTRESS
AND DETENTION FUND
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE CXII OF
2002
(An Ordinance to
amend the Women in Distress and Detention Fund Act, 1996)
[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary Part I, 5th November, 2002]
F. No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
5-11-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 5, Act
XV of 1996.---In the Women in Distress and Detention Fund Act, 1996 (XV of
1996), in section 5--
(a) in subsection
(1),---
(i) in clause
(c) the word "and" shall be omitted;
(ii) in clause
(d) for the full stop, at the end, the semicolon and word "and" shall
be substituted; and
(iii) after
clause (d) amended as aforesaid the following new clause shall be added,
namely:---
"(e) any
income from the investment of the amount credited to the Fund"; and
(b) after
subsection (2) the following new subsection shall be added, namely:--
"(3) The
capital of the fund in full or a part thereof may be invested in any Government
savings scheme and the interest profit or earnings thus obtained may be
utilized for the purposes of the Fund."
